channel.title: Crumb Structure
channel.description: Fresh takes for home sourdough bakers.

item.title: Starter Activity Shapes Crumb Openings
item.description: Active starter gives rise to airy holes; a sluggish starter leaves a dense crumb.

item.title: High Hydration Dough for Open Crumb
item.description: Raising dough hydration unlocks larger holes, but handling gets trickier.

item.title: Scoring Technique Controls Crumb Expansion
item.description: Where you slash the loaf directs gas release and shapes the crumb.

item.title: Whole‑Grain Flour and Crumb Density
item.description: Whole‑grain flours add flavor but can tighten crumb if not managed.

item.title: Autolyse Boosts Crumb Structure
item.description: A simple rest before mixing improves gluten and opens the crumb.

item.title: Fermentation Time Shapes Crumb Contrast
item.description: Long, cool fermentations deepen flavor and create a varied crumb pattern.
